description:
A 3D printing technician needs to prepare a part for printing, but the source file is damaged. 

1. Import the mesh file located at '~/Documents/FreeCAD/damaged_bracket.stl'.
2. Use the Mesh Workbench to analyze and repair the mesh. You must close all holes to make the mesh 'watertight' (a solid single component).
3. The part is being printed in ABS plastic which shrinks. Scale the repaired mesh uniformly by a factor of 1.02 (2% larger) to compensate.
4. Export the final repaired and scaled mesh to '~/Documents/FreeCAD/ready_to_print.stl' in binary STL format.
